value.headline: NOR edges it
value.summary: Norwegian driver NOR is the overall better performer, winning the head-to-head comparison 2-1 and finishing on average 2.667 places ahead of VER. NOR also leads in race pace (95.78 s/lap vs 96.169 s/lap), result (2.667 places vs 9 places), consistency (3.56 s vs 3.807 s) and positions gained (1.333 places vs –5 places). VER shows strength in tyre management (-0.018 s/lap vs 0.048 s/lap), overtaking (6 vs 5 overtakes) and peak pace (90.411 s vs 90.54 s). The comparison is limited by the fact that VER did not finish one of the three races, which drags down their result and pace averages.
caveats: VER did not finish 1 of these races, which drags their result and pace averages.
value.rule_summary: NOR leads on result, positions gained, consistency, race pace, most clearly on result (6.333 places). VER answers on tyre management, overtaking, peak pace. Across 3 races: head-to-head 1-2, NOR faster by 0.389s per lap on average, points 28-52.
